chatWrapper: .fuse-chat-wrapper { display:flex; flex-direction:column; height:100%; font-family: var(--jp-ui-font-family, Inter, Arial, sans-serif); color: var(--jp-ui-font-color1, #222); }
chatHeader: .fuse-chat-header { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #e6e6e6; background:var(--jp-layout-color1, #fff);}
bubbleUser: .fuse-chat-bubble-user { display:inline-block; background:#2563eb; color:white; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:12px; max-width:80%; }
bubbleCopilot: .fuse-chat-bubble-copilot { display:inline-block; background:#eef2ff; color:#1e293b; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:12px; max-width:80%; }
controls: .fuse-chat-controls { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:8px; border-top:1px solid #e6e6e6; }
btn: .fuse-chat-button { padding:8px 10px; border-radius:6px; background:var(--jp-brand-color1, #2563eb); color:white; border:none; cursor:pointer; }
smallBtn: .fuse-chat-small { padding:6px 8px; border-radius:6px; border:1px solid #ddd; background:white; cursor:pointer; }
